fileNodes.name: camera.py
fileNodes.summary: Manages the RealSense D455 video pipeline: starts depth+color streaming, builds the depth post-processing filter chain and depth-to-color alignment block, and locks auto-exposure/white-balance so TSDF colors stay consistent across a scan.

fileNodes.name: capture.py
fileNodes.summary: Defines CaptureSession, the realtime capture loop that orchestrates camera+IMU acquisition, IMU-primed frame-to-model tracking with relocalization, TSDF integration, background frame recording, and crash-safe finalization into the offline refinement pipeline.

fileNodes.name: frameio.py
fileNodes.summary: Handles frame and metadata I/O: a background-threaded FrameWriter that saves depth/color PNGs and JPEGs without blocking the tracking loop, plus loaders for recorded RGB-D frames and the JSON scan metadata used by the offline refinement pipeline.

fileNodes.name: mapping.py
fileNodes.summary: TSDF voxel block grid operations: extracting and exporting point clouds/meshes in 8-bit-RGB legacy format for external viewer compatibility, and the offline re-integration pass that re-fuses recorded frames at a finer voxel resolution.

fileNodes.name: pipeline.py
fileNodes.summary: Offline reconstruction pipeline shared by live capture and --refine-only: optimizes the tracked trajectory via pose-graph optimization, re-integrates recorded frames, saves the point cloud, and can rebuild a full scan from a previous session's frames directory without touching the camera.

fileNodes.name: tracking.py
fileNodes.summary: Shared RGB-D odometry helper wrapping Open3D's multi-scale hybrid odometry with tuned convergence criteria, used by realtime tracking, relocalization, and the pose graph for any tracking path that needs an initial transformation.

fileNodes.name: config.py
fileNodes.summary: Module-level tuning constants for tracking health, relocalization, loop closure, and IMU gyro integration, each documented with guidance on which to adjust first when adapting the scanner to a new environment.

fileNodes.name: imu.py
fileNodes.summary: Implements gyro-aided tracking support: accumulates high-rate IMU angular-velocity samples arriving between video frames into a rotation prior for RGBD odometry, and starts a dedicated librealsense pipeline for the motion module.

fileNodes.name: posegraph.py
fileNodes.summary: Builds and optimizes an offline keyframe pose graph from tracked frames — odometry edges between consecutive keyframes plus loop-closure edges between spatially close, temporally distant keyframe pairs — then propagates the corrected keyframe poses onto every in-between frame via interpolation.

fileNodes.name: transforms.py
fileNodes.summary: Small SO(3)/SE(3) math helpers (rotation-vector exponential map, geodesic rotation angle, rigid-transform interpolation) built on cv2.Rodrigues, avoiding a scipy dependency.

fileNodes.name: realtime_pointcloud.py
fileNodes.summary: Thin backwards-compatibility entry point at the project root that delegates straight to scanner.cli.main, kept so the scanner can still be launched as a standalone script.

fileNodes.name: __main__.py
fileNodes.summary: Package execution hook that lets the scanner be launched via `python -m scanner`, delegating to scanner.cli.main.

fileNodes.name: cli.py
fileNodes.summary: Command-line interface for the D455 scanner: defines all CLI arguments (voxel sizes, depth range, keyframe thresholds, IMU/mesh/view toggles) and the main() function that dispatches to either offline refinement or a full realtime capture session.

fileNodes.name: .understandignore
fileNodes.summary: Ignore-pattern list used by the Understand-Anything analysis tool to exclude paths from codebase scanning; a tool artifact, not part of the D455 scanner's own source or architecture.

fileNodes.name: config.json
fileNodes.summary: Single-key configuration file for the Understand-Anything analysis tool specifying the output language for generated content; a tool artifact unrelated to the scanner's own configuration.

fileNodes.name: README.md
fileNodes.summary: Top-level project documentation for the D455 realtime RGB-D scanner: explains the two-phase capture/offline pipeline, requirements, run instructions, key bindings, output files, crash recovery, project layout, tuning parameters, and scanning tips.

fileNodes.name: pyproject.toml
fileNodes.summary: Python packaging configuration (setuptools build backend) declaring the d455-scanner project's metadata, dependencies (numpy, opencv-python, open3d, pyrealsense2), and the `d455-scan` console-script entry point mapped to scanner.cli:main.

fileNodes.name: __init__.py
fileNodes.summary: Package root for the scanner module; its docstring documents the two-phase reconstruction pipeline and maps out the responsibilities of every submodule.
